photos.c: Our Honorary Treasurer John Baker, that's the one without the hair, takes up the running for the 'B' team in the exalted position of 18th during Surrey AC's cross country relay. Mike Riley, at present unable to represent the Club in the 'A' team whilst undergoing a qualifying period, went on to clock 55:55 in the following day's Walton '10'.
